changes: 🔤 Mob token letters (A, B, C) now only show when the same mob is on the current map more than once. A character placed on several maps no longer gets an A

🧘 When an item or spell reaches a new upgrade tier, the Dungeon AI meditates on how you play and offers 3 upgrade trees of 3 steps each. Pick one with the new Choose your path button: you get its first step now, and each later tier unlocks the next step to Claim
🏆 New achievement: Fully Evolved, for finishing all 3 steps of an upgrade tree. Trees can also rename the item
🎲 DMs can see every upgrade tree in progress in the DM Console's Upgrades tab, read what the AI wrote, and Re-roll trees to ask again. If the AI is unavailable, ready-made trees are offered instead
🔒 Right-click Upgrade on a weapon (free editing) is now DM-only
🌫️ Players no longer glimpse the map for a moment before its fog of war appears when the DM starts Show Time or switches maps. The map stays hidden behind "Loading map..." until its fog is ready

🙈 DMs can hide the Item Library (Inventory page) and the Spell Library (Spells page) from players with a Shown to players / Hidden from players switch next to each library title. Players still see their own items and known spells

✨ DMs can give upgrades to a crawler's item or spell from the new Upgrades tab in the DM Console: bigger dice, more range, a new damage type, splash, stat bonuses, languages, defenses, on-hit effects, new actions or something strange, and can rename the item or spell. Each one is posted to the dice log
💀 Upgrades can be cursed bargains: a stat penalty, an HP or mana cost on every use, an item that turns to dust when taken off, or one that can't be taken off. Cursed items get a red Cursed mark
🏆 New achievements: Sharpened (first weapon upgrade), Hardened (first armor upgrade), Spellwright (first spell upgrade) and Deal With the Devil (first cursed bargain)

⬆️ Weapons, armor, gear and spells now earn upgrade XP from how you use them: damage, kills and boss kills for weapons, casts, damage, healing and effects for spells, and rolls boosted by a ring or other gear. Once an item or spell earns some XP, a gold Tier bar under it shows progress, and tapping it shows where the XP came from
⚙️ DMs can set how an item or spell earns upgrade XP, and the XP needed for each tier, under Upgrade XP when creating or editing it. New items start with recommended values

⚔️ Weapon proficiency: every attack that hits a hostile mob builds proficiency with that weapon type, and each rank is +1 to hit with it, up to +10. Unarmed Strike builds Hand to Hand proficiency. A proficiency shows on the Skills tab once you've landed a hit with it, and on weapon cards

🎯 Actions tab skill buttons now use your skill ranks and roll against the chosen Easy, Medium or Hard DC, which the Actions and Skills tabs share. Perception and Science & Engineering are now on the Actions tab too
✨ Skills level up from skill XP: passing a check earns 5 XP for that skill, and each rank needs more XP than the last, up to rank 10. XP never resets
📈 Level-ups now give 100 skill XP to spend instead of a skill point, so you can split it across skills or take several ranks at once. Old ranks and unspent points carry over

🎭 The Stats tab also tracks fighting style (fights survived, feet per turn, times knocked out), talking and trading (NPC chats, Persuasion, haggles, gold earned and spent, gear swaps), progress (quests, loot boxes) and habits (turn time, undone turns, voice vs typed chat), plus a log of each crawler's 10 latest standout moments

🧠 DMs see Play Style tags on each crawler's Stats tab (Striker, Healer, Talker, Loose cannon, Troublemaker and more), worked out against the party, with a Copy AI profile button. Players don't see their tags

📊 The game now keeps count of how each crawler plays: attacks, hits, damage, kills and best hit for every weapon and spell, damage types, the mobs you kill most, boss kills, healing done and received, friendly fire, damage to neutral mobs and NPCs, and dice luck (natural 20s and 1s, average d20, checks passed, rolls per ability). It's all on the Stats tab

📊 The profile's Activity section now shows just the 5 stats where each crawler stands out most compared with the party. A new Stats tab lists every stat with the crawler's party rank and their Looting level
🎲 Skill checks roll against Easy, Medium or Hard DCs that rise 2 per dungeon floor, which the DM sets. A natural 1 always fails and a natural 20 always succeeds, haggling included
🎨 A "free icons used up" answer now only pauses icon generation for 30 minutes instead of the rest of the day, so a one-off hiccup can't switch icons off until tomorrow
🎨 Regenerate icon: when editing an item in the Item Library or a spell in the Spell Library, click Regenerate icon for a fresh pixel icon made from its current name and description
🎨 Generated item and spell icons now have no background and fill their space, so they sit on the page like the other icons instead of in a dark box
🎨 If a pixel icon can't be made, a short message now says why (daily limit used up, or a generator problem) instead of failing silently

⭐ Crawlers now earn XP: damage and killing blows on hostile mobs, finishing a fight, surviving it, coming back from near death, finishing quests, and spell mastery or Looting level-ups. Each grant shows in the dice history
📈 Levels come from XP with no cap. Each level gives 5% more max HP and max mana (rounded up), a skill point and an ability point, and an XP bar on the profile shows how far you are from the next one
🎯 New Skills tab with six skills: Barter, Athletics, Stealth, Perception, Medicine and Intimidation. Spend skill points on ranks and roll skill checks, which use an action like other rolls
🪙 Barter ranks up as you trade with merchants. Every 2 ranks take 1 off a merchant's Scrooge Factor for you, and each rank adds +1 to haggle rolls
🎁 DMs can award XP to one or more crawlers from the profile, scale all automatic XP from 50% to 200%, and set how much XP each quest gives
💎 Items can have a rarity (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic or Legendary), shown as a colored tag on the item, and the Item Library can be filtered by rarity
📝 Every item now has an Effects field for what it does, shown when you expand the item
🏆 Loot boxes can carry an achievement: when the DM unlocks the box, it's added to the crawler's trophies
🔥 Spells can leave effects on their targets in combat, like Burning, Stunned or Blessed, lasting a set number of the target's turns
🩸 Spell effects can deal damage or heal at the start of each of the target's turns, rolled automatically and posted to the dice history
🎯 Effect-only spells open a target picker when cast in combat, and effects show as badges under each portrait in the combat order bar. The DM can remove one early with its ✕
🎨 Pixel-art icons and mob portraits are now switched on: the free image generator is live, so new items, spells and mobs get their own pictures
🔒 Players can no longer pick Dungeon AI (DM Access) on the identity screen. Only the campaign's DM gets it
⚔️ Starting combat now only ticks the hostile mobs on the map you're on. Mobs on the episode's other maps are listed as other map and left unticked
⚔️ Dead mobs no longer get turns: Next Turn skips any mob at 0 HP
🎲 A natural 1 on an attack is a miss, so the damage window no longer opens after it
🐛 The crawler who lands the killing blow now gets their Mobs Looted credit (it was being overwritten)
🗺️ Deleting the map a game is running on now moves every player to the episode's next map, instead of leaving them on the deleted one
🗣️ Mobs the party hasn't encountered yet can be talked to in Game Chat when you're within 20 ft
🗺️ Show Time maps now open fitted to the screen on phones instead of zoomed into the top-left corner, and the map tools show icons only on phones so they take less room
🗺️ Mobs and crawlers added to an episode go to the first free spot near the middle, so crawlers no longer land on top of mobs
🧾 Editing HP on a profile (like when setting up a new crawler) no longer counts as HP Lost
🔔 Game start and end pop-ups close on their own and replace each other instead of piling up. Loot box and quest pop-ups close after 15 seconds
🐛 Weapon attack and damage rolls now add the ability modifier (STR 14 adds +2) including gear bonuses, instead of the whole ability score
⚔️ Upgraded weapons show Upgraded once, in gold after the name, and only when you actually changed something
⚔️ The weapon upgrade window can now also change the weapon's description and its stat bonuses while equipped
⚔️ Mobs can have attacks and spells: open Attacks & Spells in the mob creator to add claws, bites and other attacks with their own to-hit bonus and damage dice, and pick spells from the spell library

🧌 In combat the DM gets a panel in the top left of the map with everything the current mob can do, including weapons it has equipped. Tap one to roll it, pick a target, and the damage comes off their health bar
🎲 Mob rolls now show in the dice log under the mob's name in red, so every player sees them. Mobs the party hasn't met show as ???

🎨 New items and spells now get a pixel-art icon automatically, made by a free AI image generator from the item's name and description. When the daily free limit runs out, the app picks the closest matching icon from every icon made before

🧌 DMs can auto-generate a pixel-art portrait for new mob types: leave Auto-generate pixel portrait ticked when adding a mob, or click Generate on an existing one. When the daily limit runs out, the closest earlier portrait is used
🔒 Campaigns are now private: only the DM and players who joined can see or change a campaign's data. Before, anyone signed in with Google could edit any campaign
🔒 Wiki links now only work for web, email and wiki addresses, which closes a hole that let a wiki page run code in other players' browsers
🧑 New character creator: tap New on the Profiles page to make a crawler step by step, with a name, a backstory, ability points and languages

📜 Backstories have five parts: profession, an accomplishment, a hobby, where you were when the world ended, and the most important person, thing or animal to you. Pick a suggestion or write your own, and edit it later on your profile
🎲 New crawlers spend 10 ability points (up to 5 in one ability). Each point is +1 to rolls, and abilities left at 0 roll with disadvantage
🧍 New crawlers start as a classless Human at Level 1 with 25 HP, 3 mana and no gold
🗣️ New crawlers speak Worldspeech plus two languages of their choice, and Spanish is now a language
🌿 New Plant language for talking plants: crawlers who know it read their words, everyone else sees what the plant does
💀 New Dead language for corpses: a corpse stays silent until someone talks to it in Dead, then answers briefly and cryptically from what it knew in life
🪦 A mob at 0 HP is now dead in Game Chat: it stops talking, and only Speak with Dead gets answers out of it

✨ Spells can grant a language for their duration, like Speak with Animals (Beast) or Speak with Dead (Dead, with a limit of questions per casting). It counts down by noncombat turns and combat rounds and ends on its own
💍 Items can grant a language while equipped, like a druid's charm that lets you speak Beast
🔈 NPC voice clips are now saved as small MP3s in the game's database instead of file storage, whose free daily allowance was running out, so spoken lines reach every player again
🧠 A DM window without NPC keys no longer switches off NPC replies from another DM window that has them
🇪🇸 NPCs who speak Spanish now answer in Spanish, and everyone sees and hears the Spanish words
💤 When nobody in the party knows the language an NPC answers in, the game uses a short preset line instead of asking the AI, and makes one voice clip instead of two
🤖 Base64 lines sound like a little droid: beeps and whistles instead of a voice reading letters
💀 The DM can @ a corpse and get an answer, without Speak with Dead
🔇 Players can mute one NPC's voice by tapping the speaker next to its name in Game Chat
✂️ The burst of static some voices left after the last word is now cut off
💻 The Laptop brain's Fast setting now uses qwen3:4b-instruct-2507, the quickest model on the DM laptop, and Best quality uses qwen3:8b, falling back to Fast if it can't load
🐛 The item library on the Inventory page saves again in a campaign that had no library yet. Before, Firebase refused the save, so new library items vanished and the library stayed empty
💬 Scrolling over the Game Chat now scrolls the chat instead of zooming the map, and the same goes for the dice roller, game clock and map tools
👆 The Game Chat and the dice roller close when you click or tap anywhere else
🪟 Pop-up boxes (new spell, send gold, weapon upgrade, heal and damage targets) close when you click outside them, and now sit above the top menu so their tops aren't hidden
💀 The Mobs page and the DM Console mob list are split into Bosses, Mobs and Characters tabs
📐 More room between the backstory and the Activity section on profiles
🧭 Show Time's hidden top menu now slides down when you move the mouse anywhere along the top edge, for players too, and no longer pops open over the map tools when you reach for their buttons
📜 The DM can hand out any quest from Show Time, not only quests linked to the episode first
📜 The give-quest list now shows every crawler in the campaign, all selected by default, so picking everyone makes a Party Quest even when some crawlers aren't on the map
📜 Each quest handout keeps its own checkmarks, revealed items, claimed rewards and notes, so two groups on the same quest no longer share progress or read each other's notes
🐛 Players now get the New Quest popup for the first quest in a campaign, which was being skipped
🐉 Creature sounds for NPC voices: Goblin, Tiny, Giant, Dragon and Ghost effects, picked from the NPC's notes or chosen in the chat settings
🎭 NPCs can get an ElevenLabs character voice from your ElevenLabs account, and are then read by ElevenLabs first
🔊 Gemini voices now get only a mood tag, like [annoyance], in front of the line, so they stop reading their directions aloud
🩺 The Spoken voices settings now say why a line wasn't voiced for players, or if another game tab is making the voices
🔊 Spoken voices no longer read their directions out loud, only the NPC's line
▶️ NPC lines now play by themselves when the voice clip is ready, even if it takes a little longer, and a clip the browser holds back plays on your next tap
💰 Mob loot: when a hostile mob goes down in combat, its gold and items are looted automatically and shared by every crawler in the fight
🧪 Gold is split evenly. Items a mob has several copies of, like potions, are dealt out evenly, and anything left over goes to the party inventory
🎒 New party inventory on the Profiles page holds unclaimed loot. Any crawler can Take what they need, and the DM can take for a crawler or discard items
📜 Each kill posts a Looted line to the dice history showing who got what
💥 Some loot gets smashed: each coin and each copy of a stackable item has a chance to be destroyed when a mob is looted (25% by default, set per mob in the DM Console). Single items are never smashed
🧤 New Looting level on each crawler's profile: every mob you help loot counts, and each level makes your loot a tenth less likely to be smashed (level 10 never loses anything)
📦 Copies of the same item now always stack (Health Potion x3) in the Show Time inventory panel, loot boxes, merchant sell lists and mob item lists, not just on profiles

🗣️ Languages: crawlers and mobs now know languages (Worldspeech, Dervish, Vernonacular, Mindspeech, Ward sign, Mewmew, Base64 and Kra Kow). Lines in a language you don't know show up as gibberish in Game Chat and speech bubbles
🧠 Mindspeech only works for crawlers the DM has marked Telepathic
🐉 Mobs have a Languages picker in the DM Console. NPCs answer in the language they're spoken to in, and can't understand languages they don't know
🌐 Players who know more than one language can pick which one they speak in the Game Chat
🤝 Translators: a crawler can translate for the party, either automatically or line by line, with the option to twist what was said. Only the translator and the DM know the truth
📜 Item descriptions and quest notes can be written in a language, scrambled for crawlers who don't know it
✏️ Anyone can make up a language from the Languages box on their profile; the DM decides who else learns it
🛒 Each copy of a creature merchant now runs its own shop: Goblin A and Goblin B have separate stock, gold and haggling. Character merchants like Grimble still have one shop
🛒 Merchants: tick Is a merchant on any mob in the DM Console and give it stock, starting gold and a Scrooge Factor
🤝 In Show Time, tap a merchant within 20 ft and choose Trade with Merchant to buy their items or sell your own
📦 Merchant stock and gold are shared live by the whole party, so when one crawler buys the last knife no one else can
💰 Merchants only pay with the gold they have; if they're short, you can sell for whatever they have left
🧾 Scrooge Factor: each level makes buying 10% dearer and selling 10% cheaper

🎲 Haggle: roll Persuasion against the merchant's Haggle DC, and if you make it the DM can lower your prices one level. Haggling uses an action (your combat action, or one of your rolls between fights)
🔄 DMs can right-click a merchant in Show Time to see its stock, answer haggles and restock it

🧌 Mobs now come in two kinds: Creatures (templates like Goblin that you can place many times) and Characters (one named person who's part of the story, like Grimble). Boss is now a checkbox on either kind. Old mobs carry over automatically
🎲 Each copy of a creature on the map now has its own AI personality and talks as itself in Game Chat ("Goblin B"), so no two goblins feel the same
⚔️ Tokens can be friendly or hostile, and the DM can flip them mid-scene from the right-click menu. Hostile tokens are pre-ticked when combat starts; friendly ones can still be pulled in
📖 Mob Profiles now show encountered Creatures, Bosses and Characters in separate sections. A character can be linked to its creature (Grimble is a Goblin), and meeting them reveals both
🔐 Accounts are now Google only: the email and password sign-up and sign-in options are gone, since those accounts couldn't save a profile
👤 The Set Up Profile box now shows which account you're signed in with and has a Sign out button, so you're no longer stuck in it

🐛 In Show Time, reaching for the red X or other map tools at the top right no longer pops open the top menu and shoves the tools panel down. The menu now opens only when you rest your mouse at the top-left edge for a moment
🐛 If a profile can't be saved because you're not signed in with Google, the message now says so instead of just "Failed to save profile"
🧠 Laptop NPC brain now always uses the local AI model on the DM's computer, never Groq or Gemini. Online stays the fast option that runs in the DM's tab
🐾 New Beast language for animals: crawlers who know Beast (Speak with Animals) read what the creature means, everyone else sees what it does, like *squeaks twice and backs toward the hole*
🤐 Silent checkbox on mobs: oozes, constructs and the like never talk in Game Chat and can't be @ mentioned

🧠 NPCs now remember conversations: once a chat with an NPC goes quiet, the AI saves a few notes and how the NPC feels about each crawler, and the NPC brings them up next time. Characters remember for the whole campaign; creature copies for their episode
✏️ DMs can see, edit or wipe what each NPC remembers from the brain icon in the Game Chat settings
👂 NPCs now follow more of the conversation (the last 25 messages they heard, up from 10), but only what they could have heard: nothing from other maps or out of earshot, in replies or in memory

🔊 Spoken voices: NPCs can now say their lines out loud. Turn on Spoken voices in the Game Chat settings and every NPC line is read aloud on every player's device, in a voice picked from the NPC's Voice and manner notes
🎙️ DMs can pick each NPC's voice (28 American and British voices) and speed in the Game Chat settings, and tap ▶ to hear it
🗣️ If a player doesn't know the language an NPC is speaking, they hear the scrambled words, so it sounds foreign
🔈 Everyone can mute NPC voices or change their volume from the speaker icon in the Game Chat header

🎭 NPC voices sound much more natural: lines are now read by Gemini voices, told who the NPC is and how they talk, so a gruff dwarf sounds gruff. When Gemini's free use runs out, Groq takes over, then ElevenLabs, then the Kokoro voices in the DM's browser
🔑 Add an ElevenLabs key next to the Groq and Gemini keys in the Game Chat settings. The settings show which voice service is in use and when the others are back
🎚️ The Kokoro backup voices now use the full-quality model
💬 After you @ a mob, the chat remembers who you're talking to, so you don't need to @ them every message. The "No one by that name" popup no longer appears once a name is picked
🐛 NPCs now listen as soon as the DM opens an episode in Show Time, instead of waiting for the game to be started
🗣️ Every mob can now talk in Game Chat, not just ones with a personality card. Hidden mobs stay quiet
🎲 Mobs without a personality get one written by the AI from their name, description, abilities and items, plus random traits so no two are alike. It includes a secret and a Persuasion DC
💬 Type @ in Game Chat to pick who you're talking to from a list
📏 Players can only talk to mobs within 20 ft of their crawler; the @ list shows only mobs in range, with their distance

🧠 New NPC brain setting in the Game Chat: NPCs can now talk using free online AI (Groq, with Gemini as backup) straight from the DM's browser, no install needed. Laptop mode still runs on the DM's computer
🔄 When Groq's free requests run out, NPCs switch to Gemini automatically, and the laptop covers if both are used up
🔑 DMs paste their free Groq and Gemini keys in the chat settings; keys stay in the DM's browser and are never shared
🖱️ Laptop NPC voices now has one-click NPC Voices ON / OFF desktop shortcuts instead of always running at sign-in; OFF frees the model's memory
💬 The Game Chat header now says which brain is answering, and the settings panel scrolls on phones
💬 New Game Chat in Show Time: players chat as their crawler and the DM as the DM, with a hold-to-talk microphone that turns speech into text
🗣️ Talking NPCs: give a mob a personality in the DM Console and it speaks for itself in Show Time, with lines in speech bubbles over its head and in the chat
🤫 NPC secrets stay hidden from the AI until the DM unlocks them; the DM gets an Unlock / Not yet prompt when a player meets the reveal condition
🎲 NPCs can have a Persuasion DC: a crawler who rolls Persuasion high enough next to them gets the DM an Unlock / Not yet prompt for the secret
⚙️ DM chat settings: turn NPC voices on or off, pick Best quality or Fast, mute NPCs, lock secrets and clear the chat
👾 Unencountered mobs can now join combat, and players see them in the turn order. The DM can reveal a mob from the combat panel or by right-clicking its token in Show Time (Mark Encountered)
🎬 Show Time no longer resets when the DM refreshes or visits another page during a game; it picks up the running episode and players stay in the game
🐛 Refreshing the DM Console no longer sends the DM back to the main menu
👤 Crawler Profiles and Vernon's Library now open on your own crawler instead of the first one
🎲 Attacks, bonus actions and reactions now roll one d20 instead of two
🐢 No Child Left Behind now only runs during a game, so DMs can set up slower crawlers, and the trophy is awarded once per crawler
🗺️ Deleting a map no longer moves an episode's mobs onto the wrong map; episodes using it are updated and keep their other maps, settings and fog
📝 Saving an episode in the DM Console during a game no longer moves mobs back or restores their HP
⚔️ Combat no longer saves a copy of every crawler and mob picture, so big fights stay well under Firebase's 1 MB save limit
🗺️ Fixed maps looking squished in the DM's Map Designer — the map scale was stretching only the width. Maps now keep their shape at every scale
🗺️ Fixed tall maps in Show Time growing far past their episode scale (150% now really means 1.5x)
🎲 DMs can now force an initiative roll from the Show Time panel, rolling d20 + DEX for every crawler still waiting so combat can start
🧹 Removed the one-time "Import old content" button from the DM Console now that the old content has been brought into the campaign

👣 Feet left to move is now visible to everyone: in combat the current crawler's token shows a feet-left badge with a bar for the DM and all players, the DM sees every crawler's badge during noncombat turns, and the Game Clock panel lists feet left next to each crawler

↩️ New Undo Turn button: in combat, if you move your token by accident or click the wrong action, undo your turn to put your token, movement, actions, HP and mana back to how they were when it started. Each undo shows in the dice log

🐢 New automatic trophy, This Is For You, Bud, No Child Left Behind: when one crawler is the slowest in the campaign, their speed is raised to match the second slowest crawler (ties for slowest do nothing)
🗺️ Fixed wide maps getting squished in Show Time when an episode starts; maps now keep their shape and fit the screen
🎯 The gold selection ring on map tokens now hugs the round portrait and grows with it, instead of wrapping the health bar too
🐛 Fixed selecting or deleting a crawler token sometimes picking the wrong crawler
🪄 The Spells tab on crawler profiles is finished: see your mana and every spell you know, grouped by Action, Bonus Action and Reaction, with costs, dice, range and mastery progress
🔮 Casting a spell now spends its mana (after the mastery discount) and is blocked when you don't have enough
🎯 Damage spells roll a spell attack and let you pick targets and apply damage in combat; healing spells let you pick who to heal, capped at their max HP
📖 Spells learned from a tome's one-off custom spell now keep their full details, so they can be cast and added to the library
🏃 Crawlers now have a movement speed (60 ft by default). In combat you can only move your own crawler on its turn, and only up to your speed, with a feet-left badge while you drag
🧭 During noncombat turns each crawler can move up to twice their movement speed per turn, refilled when the DM starts the next turn
📊 New Activity section on crawler profiles: feet moved, damage dealt, killing blows, fight finishers, HP lost and near-death moments are tracked automatically
🏆 DMs can award trophies on a crawler's profile for things that can't be measured, like great roleplay. Awarding the same trophy again counts it up
🥾 Items can now have a Speed modifier that changes a crawler's movement speed
⚔️ Fixed splash damage on several targets sometimes only keeping the last target's damage
🌐 DMs can now share maps, mob types and whole episodes with the community from the DM Console (Public/Private toggle)
📜 Shared episodes are complete custom adventures — maps, mob types, mob placements, map settings and loot boxes — that other DMs can add to their campaign in one click
👥 New Community Maps, Community Mobs and Community Episodes sections in the DM Console (requires Show Public Content)
🗺️ Fixed newly uploaded maps sometimes shifting existing episodes onto the wrong map
📜 Shared episodes now include their quests (rewards and action items) — quest progress, assignments and player notes are not shared
🌐 New "Share all my content" button in the DM Console shares every item, spell, map, mob type and episode you made in the campaign at once, including older items and spells that had no creator yet
🐛 Fixed items disappearing from the item library when two people saved it at the same time — each save now only changes the items that person touched
📦 New "Import old content" button in the DM Console copies items, crawlers, mobs, maps and episodes made before campaigns existed into your campaign
👤 Maps, mobs, episodes, quests and loot boxes you create are now linked to your profile, like items and spells already were
🔖 New My Content: keep your own items and spells on your profile, outside any campaign, and add them to any campaign you play in
🐛 Fixed new email/password accounts failing to save their profile (username setup) — missing avatar was sent to Firebase as an invalid value
🐛 Fixed sharing items/spells publicly and other saves failing when optional fields were empty
🐛 Fixed edits to the sample crawlers in a brand-new campaign not saving — the crawler is now saved to the campaign on first save
⚠️ Failed saves now show an error toast instead of failing silently
⚔️ Combat Turn Timer — configurable countdown or stopwatch timer displayed in the combat order bar during active combat
⏱️ DM can toggle between countdown mode (30s/60s/90s/120s presets) and stopwatch mode from the PingPanel
🔔 Audio alert beep plays when countdown timer expires; timer flashes red to signal time's up
⏸️ DM can pause and resume the turn timer mid-combat
🧙 Renamed Spells page to Vernon's Library — a themed name for the spell management system
📖 Added Vernon's Library button to the Main Menu grid for quick access
📚 Added dedicated Spells wiki section with pages for Overview, Learning Spells, Casting & Mastery, Spell Properties, Spell Tomes, and Sharing Spells
🏠 New cinematic landing page — immersive hero section, feature showcase, combat mockup, map visualization, and animated scroll-reveal sections
🔒 Authentication required — all app content is now gated behind sign-in; anonymous access to game features is no longer allowed
🛤️ New /app route — the app now lives under /app/* with the landing page at /; authenticated users are auto-redirected to the app
🐛 Fixed crash when clicking Short Rest / Long Rest — PingPanel TDZ error resolved (playerCrawlers was referenced before its useMemo declaration)
🐛 Fixed health bars showing NaN when max HP/mana is 0 — HealthBar now guards against division by zero
🐛 Fixed effective HP/Mana stats not updating in real-time while editing a crawler's equipped items in ProfilesView
🐛 Fixed empty paragraph rendering in Mobs list when a mob has no description
🔒 Content privacy system — inventory items and spells in the shared library are now linked to the account that created them, private by default
🌐 Public content toggle — item and spell creators can mark their content as public to share with the community; a globe/lock badge shows the current status
👥 Community Items — when public content is enabled, a Community Items section appears in Inventory showing public items from other players that can be copied to your campaign library
✨ Community Spells — when public content is enabled, a Community Spells section appears in the Spell Library showing public spells from other players that DMs can add to their library
⚙️ Account Settings — a new Account Settings section in Campaign Select lets players toggle 'Show Public Content' on/off
⚠️ Age warning — enabling public content shows a confirmation dialog warning that community content may not be suitable for all ages
🏷️ Creator attribution — items and spells display the username of whoever created them
📋 Decision audit log — significant account setting changes (e.g. enabling/disabling public content) are recorded to a personal decision history in Firestore
